The journey

A coastal golf adventure through North Wales.

Arrive in London, drive to Conwy for three northern links, continue south to Harlech for three rounds along Cardigan Bay, then return to London for the final weekend.

Two-base strategy

Stay close to the golf

01

The Erskine Arms

Conwy base · September 19–22

A historic coaching inn in central Conwy, positioned for the three northern rounds and access to the town’s restaurants and castle.

  • 3 nights
  • North Wales, Bull Bay and Conwy
  • Estimated lodging allocation: about $550–$570 per person
02

The Cottage Inn

Harlech base · September 22–26

A southern base for Porthmadog, Nefyn and Royal St. David’s, with Snowdonia and Cardigan Bay nearby.

  • 4 nights
  • Porthmadog, Nefyn and Royal St. David’s
  • Verify booking dates and cost against the reservation

Travel notes

Before you go

Drive on the left

Allow extra time on rural roads and choose an automatic rental if it makes the transition easier.

Pack for wind and rain

Bring waterproofs, layers, extra gloves, and a compact umbrella suitable for links conditions.

Confirm tee times

Recheck visitor policies, handicaps, green fees and cancellation rules before departure.

Use live navigation

Open each journey in Google Maps on the travel day for current traffic and road closures.
